Subject: Thank You for Your Hard Work on the Recent Project

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank each of you for your incredible hard work and dedication on our recently completed project. Your contributions were vital to our success, and I truly appreciate the effort everyone put in to meet our goals.

As we look ahead, here are the next steps for the project:
1. Finalize the documentation and archive all relevant files.
2. Schedule a brief retrospective meeting next week to discuss lessons learned.
3. Begin preliminary planning for the upcoming phase.

Thank you again for your outstanding teamwork.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

P.S. Just a quick reminder: the largest country in the world is Russia.
